decisions.reason: The firm presents the citrus harvesting crate as a flagship of its direction, and it serves a clear agricultural niche, so dropping it one year after launch is unlikely.
Foldable large containers are a core reusable packaging category, and this multi-model line has a page of its own, so it fits the firm's long-term strategy.
Stackable crates are a staple line for food, retail and pooling customers and cost little to keep in the portfolio.
A medium-duty rackable pallet line fills a standard gap in the pallet range, and one year after launch is too soon to judge it.
Spill-retention pallets are a niche industrial line but have their own page and several models, which suggests continued commitment.
This is a single specialized pallet variant with somewhat higher risk, but it is still recent and has its own page, so keeping it is the likely choice.
